climate_pressure: 2024 wildfire hazard in the Chaco; ignition is not attributed here to climate change.
documented_impact: Fire threatens habitat used by Ayoreo people in voluntary isolation.
fcv_mediator: Habitat destruction could force unwanted contact where territorial and non-contact safeguards are inadequate.
possible_consequence: Conditional exposure to violence and disease and threats to physical/cultural survival; no contact or violence event is asserted.
alternative_explanations: Land-use pressures and deforestation also affect habitat independently of climate.
Extent of damage in uncontacted territory was unknown to the mission.
uncertainty: Source-stated conditional protection mechanism, not a verified violence outcome, precise exposure map or anthropogenic attribution of the fires. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Territorial protection and fire prevention must respect peoples' right to remain in voluntary isolation; do not use this pathway to justify forced contact.
compact_statement: Wildfire habitat loss could force unwanted contact and heighten violence risk for isolated Ayoreo; REDESCA does not report that this occurred.
